initDB() error {\n\tvar err error\n\tdb, err = sql.Open(\"sqlite\", dbFile)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := db.Ping(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tExpression string `json:\"expression\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, := \"trivial\"\n\tif adjusted >= totals.deadly {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"deadly\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.hard {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"hard\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.medium {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"medium\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.easy {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"easy\"\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{\n\t\t\"base_xp\":       baseXP,\n\t\t\"monster_count\": bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(hash), []byte(password)) == nil\n}\n\nfunc registerHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tUsername string {\n\tswitch {\n\tcase level >= 17:\n\t\treturn 6\n\tcase level >= 13:\n\t\treturn 5\n\tcase level >= 9:\n\t\treturn 4\n\tcase level >= 5:\n\t\treturn 3\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn 2\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc computeInitiative(combatants []combatantInput) []orderEntry {\n\tscored := make([]struct {\n\t\tname  string\n\t\tdex   int\n\t\tscore int\n\t}, len(combatants))\n\tfor i, c := range combatants {\n\t\tscored[i] = struct {\n\t\t\tname  string\n\t\t\tdex   int\n\t\t\tscore int\n\t\t}{name: c.Name, dex: c.Dex, score: c.Roll + c.Dex}\n\t}\n\n\tsort.Slice(scored, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif scored[i].score != scored[j].score {\n\t\t\treturn scored[i].score > scored[j].score\n\t\t}\n\t\tif scored[i].dex != scored[j].dex {\n\t\t\treturn scored[i].dex > scored[j].dex\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn
